To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

a GAN based framework is able to generate photo realistic natural images at 4x super resolution, that the perceptual loss function consisting of an adversarial and content loss plays a critical role in achieving photo realism, that the adversarial loss is able to push the solution towards the natural image manifold and that the content loss ensures that the high level structures of the image are maintained.
a generative adverserial network can learn a photo realistic SR model and that a perceptual loss can be used to improve the perceptual quality of SR.
we propose SRGAN, a GAN based framework for single image super resolution that produces images of high perceptual quality and that SRGAN outperforms all existing SR methods.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the question: how do we generate high resolution photo realistic images using deep neural networks?
the question: can we super resolve images at large scales and obtain photo realistic results?
the question of how to generate photo realistic images at high upscaling factors.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
SRGAN is able to recover high frequency details and photo realistic textures from low resolution images.
SRGAN can generate high resolution images that are more realistic and have better perceptual qualities than state-of-the-art methods.
SRGAN is a novel framework that uses a generative adverserial network to produce photo realistic images from single images at large scale factors.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
SRGAN is the first method which can generate photo realistic images from LR images.
we are able to recover photo-realistic textures from downsampled images at a large upscaling factor using a deep generative model trained with a novel perceptual loss function.
SRGAN is the first SR method that can learn the true distribution of natural images.
The main takeaway from our work is that
a GAN is capable of recovering photo realistic textures from single images without any guidance from external data and without any hand crafted priors.
GANs can be used to recover photo realistic details in single image super resolution, which is not achievable with other existing techniques.
a GAN based framework can be used for SR to recover photo realistic images.
